v1.0.0.description:
Everything needed to set up the randomizer, per the README:

- **nubbys_number_factory.apworld** - install into your Archipelago custom_worlds folder.
- **PatchApItemLockV30_MASTER.csx** - UndertaleModTool script to patch your own, legally-owned data.win.
- **nnf_poptracker_pack.zip** - PopTracker pack for visual check tracking.

See the README for full setup steps.
v1.0.0.title: v1.0.0 - Setup files

v1.1.0.description:
Adds a `/patch` command to the in-game client - patches your own data.win directly (downloads UndertaleModCli automatically on first use), no manual UndertaleModTool steps needed. See the README for the updated setup flow; the old manual method still works and is documented under Advanced setup.

- **nubbys_number_factory.apworld** - install into your Archipelago custom_worlds folder, then run /patch from the client.
- **PatchApItemLockV30_MASTER.csx** - for manual/advanced patching only.
- **nnf_poptracker_pack.zip** - PopTracker pack for visual check tracking.
v1.1.0.title: v1.1.0 - /patch command

v1.2.0.description:
Fixes two accessibility bugs caught by fuzz-testing this apworld with Eijebong's Archipelago fuzzer (300/300 clean generations after these fixes):

- **Unreachable supervisor locations**: regions were built for all 11 supervisors regardless of the `supervisors_in_pool` option, but only that many ever get an unlock item - any excluded supervisor's Win location was permanently unreachable.
- **Supervisor Unlock items getting randomly trimmed**: when the item pool exceeded the location count, the whole pool was shuffled and truncated with no protection for progression items, so a needed Supervisor Unlock could get discarded.

Also adds an `archipelago.json` manifest (current Archipelago logs a deprecation warning without one).

- **nubbys_number_factory.apworld** - install into your Archipelago custom_worlds folder, then run /patch from the client.
- **PatchApItemLockV30_MASTER.csx** - for manual/advanced patching only.
- **nnf_poptracker_pack.zip** - PopTracker pack for visual check tracking.
v1.2.0.title: v1.2.0 - Fuzzer-caught accessibility fixes

v1.2.1.description:
Hardens the synchronous supervisor-save sync (used in the supervisor select screen, the arrow-switch buttons, and a periodic refresh) against a crash: two players hit `Variable <unknown_object>.SVCost(...) not set before reading it` in `obj_SupervisorMGMT_Create_0` after clicking through Classic Mode, on v1.2.0, patched via `/patch`.

The SVCost fix itself (from very early in this project) was independently re-verified correct and present in the exact shipped build via a fresh decompile - so this wraps the adjacent save-file read/JSON-parse in try/catch, since an uncaught exception there would abort the whole Create event (including code that runs after it) and could surface exactly like this given GameMaker's unreliable post-recompile line info.

- **nubbys_number_factory.apworld** - install into your Archipelago custom_worlds folder, then run /patch from the client.
- **PatchApItemLockV30_MASTER.csx** - for manual/advanced patching only.
- **nnf_poptracker_pack.zip** - PopTracker pack for visual check tracking (unchanged this release).
v1.2.1.title: v1.2.1 - Harden supervisor-save sync

v1.2.2.description:
Root-caused the crash reported after v1.2.1: decompiled the affected player's actual `data.win` and confirmed it was 100% unpatched vanilla (no trace of the AP patch anywhere), while their save file had a supervisor locked - which only happens via this client's own logic. `/patch` had silently failed for them, most likely because the game got launched during the multi-minute operation and the final swap raced a locked file - the running-game check only happened once, at the very start.

- `/patch` now re-checks right before swapping data.win, wraps the swap in try/except, and verifies the patch marker is actually present in the output (and the live file) before reporting success. On any failure the correctly-patched file is preserved so nothing needs to be redone from scratch.
- The client now checks on every connect/reconnect and prints a loud, hard-to-miss warning if your live `data.win` doesn't look patched.

Verified for real by running the actual patch code end-to-end against a fake install, both the success path and the game-launched-mid-patch failure path.

- **nubbys_number_factory.apworld** - install into your Archipelago custom_worlds folder, then run /patch from the client.
- **PatchApItemLockV30_MASTER.csx** - for manual/advanced patching only.
- **nnf_poptracker_pack.zip** - PopTracker pack for visual check tracking (unchanged this release).
v1.2.2.title: v1.2.2 - /patch verifies its own success

v1.3.0.description:
Removes `/patch`.

`/patch` (in-client self-patching via a downloaded UndertaleModCli) had two independent real-world failure reports trace back to it - the fix for the second one (v1.2.2) held up in testing, but the automated self-patch approach itself proved too fragile in practice. Distribution now works the same way most game mods do: download the already-patched `data.win` from this release and swap it in yourself.

**Before you do anything**, back up your own `data.win` and your save folder (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\NNF_FullVersion\`) - see the README for exact steps and how to revert back to a normal game later.


- **nubbys_number_factory.apworld** - install into your Archipelago custom_worlds folder.
- **PatchApItemLockV30_MASTER.csx** - the source this data.win was built from, for anyone who wants to verify or rebuild it themselves.
- **nnf_poptracker_pack.zip** - PopTracker pack for visual check tracking (unchanged this release).
v1.3.0.title: v1.3.0 - Pre-patched data.win, no more /patch

v1.3.1.description:
The fresh-room lock (which zeroes exactly these fields for a brand new room) only ran when a connection *also* looked like a room switch. If an earlier connection attempt got interrupted after `active_room.json` was written but before room setup finished, the next attempt skipped the lock entirely - the player's current, already-progressed save got copied straight into the "new" room unlocked. Fixed: fresh-room setup now runs whenever the room's own save folder doesn't exist yet, independent of whether the connection looks like a "switch."

This is a client-only fix (no `data.win` changes) - existing patched games don't need re-patching.

- **nubbys_number_factory.apworld** - install into your Archipelago custom_worlds folder.
- **PatchApItemLockV30_MASTER.csx** - unchanged, for anyone rebuilding it themselves.
- **nnf_poptracker_pack.zip** - unchanged.
v1.3.1.title: v1.3.1 - Fix fresh-room lock skip bug
